purpose: Sharp original RGBA leaf atlas for branching 3D wall ivy
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: production RGBA leaf texture atlas for a realistic 3D ivy plant in a stone hill-town game. Generate ONE square 2048x2048 image with actual transparent background. Exactly FOUR separate English ivy leaves, arranged on a strict two-column by two-row equal-cell grid. Each cell contains one isolated leaf viewed completely straight-on from above, with the leaf central tip pointing UP and its small petiole pointing DOWN. Leaves must stay wholly inside their own cell with at least 10% transparent margin all around. Four sharp detailed botanical English ivy leaves, 3 to 5 pointed lobes, fine pale branching veins, restrained waxiness, tiny natural imperfections, small nicks and subtle mottling. Palette variations across cells: deep olive green, medium muted green, slightly yellow new growth, weathered dark green. Consistent plausible real-world ivy shape, realistic leaf blade and a short petiole; no twigs, no whole plants. Flat neutral diffuse illumination suitable for base-color texture: no cast shadows, no directional highlights, no ambient background. Maximal clean fine leaf detail and crisp alpha edges. No text, no borders, no checkerboard painted into the image, no artificial bevel or outline, no other objects. This is an asset atlas, not a concept art rendering or scene screenshot.
atlas_layout: Two columns, two rows; OBJ V runs bottom-to-top
